* [https://web.archive.org/web/20070928014432/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/swallcards.pdf Complete Card List] (Decipher PDF, archive 28 September 2007) — Light Weapon: Anakin's Lightsaber, Hoth, R1
|strategy=Gregg (Ginsu) Keefer, [[Gold 4]]

One of only three unique lightsabers in the game so far, this can opener is especially useful to the Light Side as it deploys to any [[Luke Skywalker{{!}}Skywalker]] with ability higher than 3. With the release of the Cloud City expansion and the new [[Princess Leia]] card with her ability of 4, she can now use the family blade!

The weapon itself is devastating. In addition to adding one to Force drains it will take down even the strongest enemies and leave them with zero forfeit value at battle's end. You simply target for free, draw two destiny and watch out for falling limbs! Now how much would you pay? Add to your Force drains by combining it with [[Lightsaber Proficiency]] and jack up your power in battles by 3 to boot!

And this knife comes gauranteed for life, whoops sorry I slipped into my Ginsu routine again. Seriously though, for zero deploy, zero to use and two characters who can use it this is by far the best hand weapon for you can add to your Light Side deck. It Slices! It Dices! It makes Julienne Fries!<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/hoth/light/small/anakinslightsaber.html</ref>
